rules.title: Credential file read
rules.message: The command may read local Huawei Cloud credential or profile files into the agent context.
rules.remediation: Use huaweicloud_show_profile_redacted or user-side credential configuration instead of reading credential files.

rules.title: Cloud credential environment dump
rules.message: The command may print cloud credential environment variables.
rules.remediation: Inspect only required non-secret settings and redact secret-like values before returning output.

rules.title: Plaintext secret read
rules.message: The command appears to retrieve plaintext secret values.
rules.remediation: Use runtime secret references, user-side inspection, or redacted metadata checks instead of returning secret values to the agent.

rules.title: Plaintext adminPass exposure
rules.message: The artifact or plan contains a plaintext adminPass parameter. The password may be exposed in version control, logs, or agent context.
rules.remediation: Use userData cloud-init, KMS/CSMS secret references, or encrypted password injection instead of embedding adminPass as plaintext in deployment files.

rules.title: Temporary credential exposure
rules.message: 此操作将返回临时 AK/SK 和 SecurityToken。注意敏感数据保密，不要将凭证输出到日志或分享给第三方。
rules.remediation: 临时凭证仅用于当前会话，使用完毕后及时销毁，不要持久化存储。

rules.title: Encoded payload piped to shell
rules.message: The command decodes an encoded payload and pipes it into an interpreter.
rules.remediation: Decode payloads into a reviewable file first, inspect the content, then execute only explicit reviewed commands.

rules.title: Public admin port exposure
rules.message: The change appears to expose an administrative or database port to the public internet. Web ports (80/443) are allowed - this rule only covers admin/database ports.
rules.remediation: Restrict the source CIDR to a trusted range, use a bastion or VPN, and keep public preview endpoints behind authenticated HTTP services. For SSH troubleshooting, do NOT widen to 0.0.0.0/0: open a /32 rule for your real direct egress IP instead (detect it with Invoke-RestMethod -Uri https://api.ipify.org -NoProxy on Windows pwsh 7+ / curl --noproxy '*' on Linux — a proxy egress is NOT the direct egress; see huawei-ecs references/windows-ssh.md §0.1), or skip SSH entirely via cloud-init user_data deployment (references/create-instance.md §Bootstrap). Full SSH failure diagnosis chain: huawei-ecs references/troubleshooting.md.

rules.title: Public exposure with variable-referenced port
rules.message: The change exposes a port to the public internet (0.0.0.0/0) with the port number behind a non-literal expression (variable, function, or interpolation), so the rule engine cannot confirm whether it is an administrative port.
rules.remediation: Resolve the variable and verify the port before merging: if it is an admin/database port (22/3389/3306/5432/6379/...), restrict the source CIDR to a trusted range, a bastion, or a VPN instead of 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: Hardcoded cloud credential in artifact
rules.message: The artifact contains a literal access key, secret key, or security token. Credentials committed to IaC, config, or code leak through git history, logs, and state files.
rules.remediation: Remove the literal credential: reference it from environment variables, a DEW CSMS secret reference, or the platform credential vault (huaweicloud_secret_set), and rotate the exposed key immediately.

rules.title: OBS anonymous write
rules.message: The change may grant anonymous write or full-control access to OBS data.
rules.remediation: Use private buckets by default. Grant object read only when required, and avoid anonymous write permissions.

rules.title: Public FunctionGraph trigger without auth
rules.message: The generated FunctionGraph or API Gateway path may be publicly reachable without authentication.
rules.remediation: Require IAM, app authentication, JWT, or another explicit auth layer before exposing generated application endpoints.

rules.title: Broad IAM administrator grant
rules.message: The change appears to grant broad administrator permissions.
rules.remediation: Use least-privilege service actions, resource constraints, and short-lived credentials for generated application workflows.

rules.title: High-risk IAM write operation
rules.message: This hcloud command creates or modifies IAM principals (users, policies, roles, or agencies). These operations can grant elevated privileges.
rules.remediation: Confirm the principal name, scope, and attached permissions with the user before creating IAM users, policies, roles, or agencies.

rules.title: Forced destructive operation
rules.message: The command combines deletion with force, recursive, or cascading deletion behavior.
rules.remediation: Show the exact resources to be deleted, confirm backups or recovery path, and require explicit user approval for the exact command.

rules.title: Destructive cloud resource operation
rules.message: This hcloud command will delete, detach, or remove cloud resources. The operation may be irreversible.
rules.remediation: List the resources to be affected first, confirm with the user, and require explicit approval before executing any destructive operation.

rules.title: Destructive resource reset operation
rules.message: This hcloud command resets a cloud resource (password, metadata, or instance state). This may disrupt access or mutate the resource.
rules.remediation: Confirm the reset target with the user and require explicit approval before executing.

rules.title: Cascading cloud resource deletion
rules.message: This delete command will also remove associated resources (EIP, volume). Check that these should be deleted together.
rules.remediation: Confirm with the user whether to delete the associated resources, or set delete_publicip/delete_volume to false to keep them.

rules.title: Sandbox deployment missing cleanup metadata
rules.message: The preview or sandbox deployment does not show cleanup or ownership metadata.
rules.remediation: Add owner, purpose, expiration time, and cleanup command before creating preview cloud resources.

rules.title: Unbounded scale or high-cost resource
rules.message: The generated plan may create high-cost or unbounded capacity.
rules.remediation: Use small preview defaults, explicit quotas, budget labels, and user approval before creating high-cost resources.

rules.title: Plaintext secret in command argument
rules.message: The command passes a plaintext password or secret as a direct CLI argument, which may leak into shell history, logs, or process listings.
rules.remediation: Use environment variables, DEW secret references, or interactive prompts instead of passing secrets as command-line arguments.

rules.title: Destructive command in sandbox terminal
rules.message: The sandbox terminal command is destructively dangerous and could destroy the workspace.
rules.remediation: Use targeted deletions instead of recursive root removal. Avoid disk format, fork bombs, and system shutdown commands in sandbox terminals.
